placements.why: Both segments describe a test built specifically to demonstrate correctness against a real production failure — reproducing the exact bug pattern and asserting a safe outcome. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and neither Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/Organization/Templates/Calibration (named in the taxonomy but none supplied here) plausibly covers verification-through-reproduction work; this content names that organizational category itself.
placements.title: Correctness is demonstrated by reproducing real failures, not asserting behavior in the abstract
placements.frame: What concrete production failure or edge case does this proof point make verifiable, and does the evidence actually recreate it?

placements.title: Tests earn trust by reproducing the exact production failure, not a synthetic approximation
placements.frame: What real production failure pattern does this test recreate, and does the reproduction match it precisely (same shape of input, same missing field, same structural cause)?
placements.why: src-1 states the test's purpose as reproducing 'the missing-id failure pattern from prod' with the specific structural cause named (## level heading, no id field) — a testing-methodology theme future test envelopes will keep feeding as more prod failures get turned into regression cases. This is a subject, not a one-time fact: no existing leaf or strata (both empty for this repo) plausibly holds it, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata.

placements.title: Malformed or missing input must degrade to a valid fallback, never a crash
placements.frame: When required data is absent or malformed, does the system fail safely with a valid substitute, or does it crash?
placements.why: src-2 states a dual requirement — 'must not crash; must produce a valid slug' — as the standard the system must meet under missing-id input. This is a design/verification theme (graceful degradation as the good being enforced) distinct from the reproduction-methodology theme in src-1, and one future test envelopes will keep feeding as more crash-prevention/fallback cases accumulate. Nothing existing (structure is empty) covers it, so it is minted under the same Proof strata.
